integrity.proof_basis: Analytic strip-intersection and polygon-area derivation, with separate parity branches.

scientific_limitations: The result covers regular Euclidean polygons with \(n\ge5\).
It gives the maximal-normal locus area, not the full distribution of normal counts.
The bibliographic overlap search was bounded; an unlocated prior computation remains possible.
title: Parity law for the maximal-normal chamber of a regular polygon
